notes: The episode audio is always supplied by the user as a local file.

The complete role script is shown to and approved by the user before rendering. It contains every spoken line, named nonverbal vocalization, silence, and character assignment. Direct review, documented local analysis, user labels, or a checksum-matched approved reference may draft the beats, but transcription and diarization never approve character roles. A speaker handoff occurs only after the current speaker's last audible word; elongated phrases, internal dramatic pauses, and trailing words remain with that speaker. speaker=both requires documented simultaneous-speech evidence; uncertainty must stop for review and alternating voices must be split into single-speaker beats.

For local audio analysis, each stable detected voice ID is mapped once to the user-confirmed character for the whole episode. Never infer a character from a fixed mentor, lead, questioner, or foil archetype, and never recast a voice at a caption or apparent dialogue-turn boundary.
No speech, music, image, or video provider call occurs at runtime.
The smoke proof synthesizes a local tone only to exercise audio muxing without requiring episode content.
Cargo is required only when rebuilding PNG character poses from Toon Boom Harmony projects; normal video rendering uses the packaged PNG poses.
